train_mdnrnn: train an MDNRNN memory network model on a gym environment using random policy data
calculate_feature_importance: calculate feature importance scores for state and action features using a trained MDNRNN trainer
calculate_feature_sensitivity: calculate feature sensitivity scores for state features using a trained MDNRNN trainer
create_embed_rl_dataset: create an embedded RL dataset by running a random agent in a StateEmbedEnvironment with an MDNRNN
test_mdnrnn: test the MDNRNN model by verifying feature importance and sensitivity results against expected top features
